items.title: Submit civil marriage application on ADJD portal (via UAE Pass)
items.notes: Form in Arabic + English; declare marital status

items.title: Pay court fee
items.notes: AED 300 standard (court schedules date, ~2–3 wks) or AED 2,500 express (choose own date). Decide based on fathers' flights

items.title: Receive document approval + book ceremony date
items.notes: Book immediately — weekend slots fill fast. 24hr notice required to reschedule or application is forfeited

items.title: Ceremony day: bring original passports + Emirates IDs
Bring 2 wedding rings for exchange
items.notes: Optional at ADJD but we're doing it. Vows play via pre-recorded audio (English available); personal vows allowed

items.title: Confirm photographer/videographer allowed to shoot at court
items.notes: ADJD permits them at ceremony

items.title: Marriage certificate received via SMS + email
items.notes: 3 days standard / same day express

items.title: Order fresh PSA CENOMAR (Mark)
items.notes: Valid only 6 months for marriage purposes — order Sep–Oct 2026, NOT earlier

items.title: DFA apostille/authentication (Philippines leg)
items.notes: Family in PH can handle, or agency runs full chain

items.title: UAE MOFA attestation (final stamp, UAE side)
items.notes: Full chain via agency ~AED 500–900 if outsourcing

items.title: Check both passports valid 6+ months beyond March 2027
Emirates IDs valid through wedding date
Passport photos ready (4+ each, white background)
MOFA attestation of marriage certificate
items.notes: Recommended immediately after ceremony; needed for ROM + any future spouse visa

items.title: Complete 4 typewritten Report of Marriage forms, original signatures
Prepare original + 3 photocopies of attested marriage contract (with English translation)
4 passport photos each + 3 passport photocopies each
File ROM at Philippine Embassy Abu Dhabi
items.notes: Embassy has jurisdiction over Abu Dhabi + Al Ain. Claim after ~5 working days

items.title: Confirm PSA record months later
items.notes: This is what makes the marriage exist in PH records — never skip

items.title: Decide route: agency tourist visa vs. family visit visa
items.notes: Agency tourist visa (60-day, simplest) vs. family visit visa (Mark sponsors, AED 4,000 salary threshold + attested birth cert)

items.title: Apply for both fathers' visas
items.notes: No visa-on-arrival for PH passports without US/EU/etc. visa — pre-approved visa mandatory

items.title: Affidavit of Support (AoS) via PH Embassy/Consulate
items.notes: PH immigration checks this for parents traveling WITHOUT the resident sponsor — do not skip

items.title: Confirm fathers' hotel room (negotiate as package inclusion)
items.notes: Hotel wedding packages often include discounted family rates — negotiate before signing

items.title: Shortlist photographers (ask: who handles location permits?)
items.notes: Hired-photographer shoots in public spots may need permits; reputable studios arrange them

items.title: Book prenup shoot
items.notes: Shoot Oct–Mar window for weather; golden hour

items.title: Choose locations (cluster nearby spots)
items.notes: If hotel backdrop wanted, shoot at OUR wedding hotel — outside hotels charge AED 10k+ for shoots

items.title: No drone unless photographer has GCAA approval
items.notes: Heavily regulated

items.title: Receive edited photos + select for reception AV
Negotiate package: complimentary couple suite + fathers' room + prenup shoot access
items.notes: Three asks in one negotiation before signing

items.title: Confirm AV setup (screen for prenup video, mic for emcee)
Floor plan + decor within hotel package
Confirm hotel events manager as venue-side coordinator
items.notes: They run venue logistics free — but they work for the hotel, not us; our Day Captain covers the rest

items.title: Underwear kit: cycling shorts, bra, nipple tape, socks
Emergency kit (safety pins, hair pins, scissors, nail cutter, medicines, tissue, napkin, glue)
2 vow booklets
items.notes: Personal vows at reception even though legal vows happen at court

items.title: Game stubs (Bato Bato Pick or similar)
Emcee/host briefed with program + sponsor acknowledgment script
items.notes: Introduce each ninong/ninang with a short story; acknowledgments after welcome + before dessert

items.title: SYMBOLIC: Cord
items.notes: Flip to todo if we decide to do Filipino rites at reception

items.title: Tier 1: Bride's gift for groom / groom's gift for bride
Tier 2: Gifts for both fathers
items.notes: Something they carry home to PH

items.title: Tier 3: Principal sponsors
items.notes: AED 50–120 each. Ninangs: pashmina / skincare / candle. Ninongs: engraved pen / grooming kit. Unisex: framed prenup photo, dates+chocolates box. Deliver privately before program or after cake, handwritten note

items.title: Tier 4: Entourage / witnesses / best friends
items.notes: AED 30–60 each

items.title: Tier 5: Supplier snack boxes (photographer, videographer, HMUA, coordinator-friend)
items.notes: AED 25–40/box — fed suppliers = better photos

items.title: Tier 6: Guest giveaways
items.notes: Skippable at intimate scale; reallocate if tight

items.title: Vendor contact sheet (names + numbers in notes)
Payables envelopes prepared, labeled per vendor
Choose Day Captain (trusted friend or one father)
Handover: printed timeline, payables envelopes, supplier contact sheet, program cues
